in_marathi.name: Ayomaya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mother of the Vedas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayomaya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ayomaya is a Sanskrit name that holds immense significance in Hindu mythology. It is believed to be the mother of the Vedas, the ancient Indian scriptures that are the foundation of Hinduism. Ayomaya is a revered deity, often invoked for wisdom and knowledge. She is also associated with the creation of the universe, symbolizing the source of all life and knowledge.
